title: Mum Calls Dinner Stumps Drawn (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, there is no power greater than your mothers voice from the kitchen window
Not the umpire. Not the captain. Your mother.
Stumps are drawn.

[Verse 1]
Ninety-seven for two, ten overs to go
Last light fading on the Hills Hoist glow
Then from the window comes the sound
The most powerful force on the backyard ground

DINNERS ON THE TABLE
That is stumps. That is all. No negotiation.
Five more minutes Mum, that is not an option
The game ends at dinner, that is the backyard tradition

[Pre-Chorus]
Stumps drawn by the kitchen bell
One call from Mum, it is all farewell
Bat and ball go back to the shed
Backyard cricket, done until fed

[Chorus]
Mum calls dinner, stumps are drawn
One voice from the kitchen and the game is gone
Score remembered on the back of a hand
Mum calls dinner, every backyard land

[Verse 2]
If the score is tied when she calls it through
Draw is declared, honour is true
Come back after dinner, no resuming the play
Backyard cricket law, thats the way

[Bridge]
Bluey: AND THE GAME IS, oh, the kitchen window, stumps are drawn here at the G
Trevor: Under the Maternal Override Clause all backyard cricket must yield at first call
Chas: She only calls once son. Only once. Dont make her call twice.

[Chorus]
Mum calls dinner, stumps are drawn
One voice from the kitchen and the game is gone
Score remembered on the back of a hand
Mum calls dinner, every backyard land

[Outro]
Wash your hands
And dont track grass through the kitchen
Thats my boy
